children: Agentic AI is expected to take off at lightning speed over the next year and permeate the retail sector from top to bottom. Morgan Stanley thinks the auto retail sector is particularly interesting in an agentic world due to the combination of a "high-ticket, infrequent purchase and a historically friction-laden customer experience."

The Morgan Stanley analyst team noted that online aggregators have long improved vehicle price and inventory discovery, but purchasing a vehicle still requires consumers to navigate thousands of listings and dealers, compare imperfectly standardized offers, and evaluate financing/trade-in terms as they work toward negotiating the final transaction. Meta's

Muse and other consumer AI agents are expected to reduce that friction meaningfully by performing more of that work on the consumer's behalf, including being tasked to search inventory, comparing all-in economics, and ultimately helping negotiate and make the final auto-buying transaction. The conclusion is that retail auto buyers will be clear winners.
The firm thinks the implications for franchise dealers such as Asbury Automotive Group

are nuanced but skew negative. "An agent capable of simultaneously comparing vehicle prices, fees, financing, and trade-in offers – and eventually contacting or negotiating with multiple dealers – could make it more difficult to sustain an uncompetitive all-in offer simply because a consumer entered the dealership or recognized the brand," warned the MS analyst team.

is seen as the best positioned because it combines broad national inventory with a vertically integrated logistics and reconditioning network and a digital transaction architecture designed to take consumers from discovery through financing, trade-in, and purchase. Agentic discovery could amplify those advantages, providing an agent with a more readily executable end-to-end transaction than auto retail rivals. It was noted that a lower-cost retailer such as Carvana
also has greater flexibility to offer attractive consumer prices while preserving unit economics.

title: Winners and losers as agentic AI enters the car-buying process
